prompt: Draw a clean black-outlined table with a tablecloth and two stools. The table is viewed from slightly above in perspective. Draw a broad quadrilateral tabletop, a hanging tablecloth with a gently wavy lower edge, and two small stools positioned in front of the table.

steps.name: tabletop_surface
steps.description: Draw the visible top surface of the table as a wide perspective quadrilateral.

elements.placement: Wide tabletop viewed slightly from above. The back edge is shorter and higher, while the front corners are lower.

steps.name: tablecloth_front
steps.description: Draw the front hanging section of the tablecloth beneath the front edge of the tabletop.

elements.placement: The cloth begins at the left and right tabletop corners. Its bottom edge hangs across the front with several gentle waves and a deeper central fold.

steps.name: tablecloth_left_side
steps.description: Close the visible left side of the hanging tablecloth.

elements.placement: Short nearly vertical cloth edge descending from the left-front tabletop corner.

steps.name: tablecloth_right_side
steps.description: Close the visible right side of the hanging tablecloth.

elements.placement: Short vertical cloth edge descending from the right tabletop corner.

steps.name: center_cloth_fold
steps.description: Add the prominent central fold hanging from the front edge of the tabletop.

elements.placement: Short curved fold descending from the tabletop toward the central low point of the cloth.
Matching fold line on the right side of the central hanging section.

steps.name: left_front_table_leg
steps.description: Draw the front-left table leg emerging from behind the hanging cloth.

elements.placement: Narrow rectangular leg descending vertically beneath the left side of the cloth.

steps.name: left_rear_table_leg
steps.description: Draw the narrow rear-left/center leg visible beneath the cloth.

elements.placement: Shorter visible leg partly hidden behind the front tablecloth.

steps.name: center_front_table_leg
steps.description: Draw the long central/front table leg visible below the deepest portion of the cloth.

elements.placement: Long narrow leg descending from behind the central cloth fold.

steps.name: right_table_leg
steps.description: Draw the right table leg visible beneath the right side of the cloth.

elements.placement: Narrow right-side leg descending from behind the cloth.

steps.name: left_stool_seat
steps.description: Draw the small stool positioned in front-left of the table.

elements.placement: Small perspective stool seat shaped like a shallow quadrilateral.
Short visible front thickness of the stool seat.

steps.name: left_stool_left_leg
steps.description: Draw the left leg of the left stool.

elements.placement: Thin stool leg angled slightly outward.

steps.name: left_stool_right_leg
steps.description: Draw the right/front leg of the left stool.

elements.placement: Longer visible stool leg descending from the front-right portion of the seat.

steps.name: left_stool_rear_leg
steps.description: Draw the far-right rear leg of the left stool.

elements.placement: Narrow rear stool leg visible on the right side.

steps.name: right_stool_seat
steps.description: Draw the second stool positioned in front-right of the table.

elements.placement: Perspective quadrilateral seat matching the left stool.
Visible seat thickness around the front of the stool.

steps.name: right_stool_left_leg
steps.description: Draw the left leg of the right stool.

elements.placement: Thin leg angled slightly outward.

steps.name: right_stool_center_leg
steps.description: Draw the long central/front leg of the right stool.

elements.placement: Long front stool leg descending nearly vertically.

steps.name: right_stool_right_leg
steps.description: Draw the far-right leg of the right stool.

elements.placement: Narrow rear/right stool leg angled slightly outward.
